Reasoning: The pattern of exactly three dynamic object channels (1, 2, 4) and two ignored channels (0, 3) matches a game with an agent, a movable box, and a target. Sokoban has precisely these elements: agent, box, target, plus wall and floor. The 10×10 grid with an outer wall border and an inner 8×8 playable area is the classic layout of Sokoban levels. Other grid games are less consistent: Snake would have head, body, and food but no separate target; Maze with keys/doors would require more dynamic channels; Pacman would have pellets and ghosts, giving more large-weight channels. The presence of a target channel and the need to push a box onto it strongly points to Sokoban.
